_comment: Files from the Unofficial MusicXML test suite (Reinhold Kainhofer; cuthbertLab fork, MIT, see LICENSE) that tools/run_musicxml.py does not expect to engrave cleanly, and why. A "defect" entry must still fail; its passing is an error. See that tool's docstring for the format.

02a-Rests-Durations.xml.defect: engine, session 20: with the Kite include LilyPond reports 'Improbable offset for stencil: inf/-inf staff space' and 'Infinity or NaN encountered' on the rests, then aborts on a skyline assertion (exit 3); the plain conversion engraves cleanly

02b-Rests-PitchedRests.xml.defect: engine, session 20: the -inf/inf stencil offset on rests aborts LilyPond (exit 3), as 02a; clean without the Kite include

02c-Rests-MultiMeasureRests.xml.defect: engine, session 20: the -inf/inf stencil offset on rests aborts LilyPond (exit 3), as 02a; clean without the Kite include

41b-MultiParts-MoreThan10.xml.defect: engine, session 20: 'Improbable offset for stencil: -inf staff space' with the Kite include only

24c-GraceNote-MeasureEnd.xml.note: engine, for session 20 to triage: with the Kite include only, LilyPond cannot quant a grace-note beam and places it unquanted

24d-AfterGrace.xml.note: engine, for session 20 to triage: as 24c

24e-GraceNote-StaffChange.xml.note: engine, for session 20 to triage: as 24c

61g-Lyrics-NameNumber.xml.defect: musicxml2ly 2.24 crashes: 'ValueError: No closing quotation' in shlex; 2.26's converts it

61k-Lyrics-SpannersExtenders.xml.defect: musicxml2ly 2.24 crashes: 'ValueError: No closing quotation' in shlex; 2.26's converts it
